Field description: Used to specify the locations and relevant attributes of all source datasets (BIDS or not).
Valid keys in each object include `"URL"`, `"DOI"` (see
[URI](SPEC_ROOT/common-principles.md#uniform-resource-indicator)), and
`"Version"` with
[string](https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_json_datatypes.asp)
values.
Field description: Manufacturer of the equipment that produced the measurements.

must be number

Field description: Sampling frequency (in Hz) of all the data in the recording,
regardless of their type (for example, `2400`).
Field description: Length of the recording in seconds (for example, `3600`).

Field description: Defines whether the recording is `"continuous"`, `"discontinuous"`, or
`"epoched"`, where `"epoched"` is limited to time windows about events of
interest (for example, stimulus presentations or subject responses).
Required initial column 5 not found.
Format "string" must be number

codeMessages.UNKNOWN_BIDS_VERSION:
The BIDSVersion field of 'dataset_description.json' does not match a known release.
The BIDS Schema used for validation may be out of date.
codeMessages.README_FILE_MISSING:
The recommended file /README is missing.
See Section 03 (Modality agnostic files) of the BIDS specification.
codeMessages.TOO_FEW_AUTHORS:
The 'Authors' field of 'dataset_description.json' should contain an array of values -
with one author per value.
This was triggered based on the presence of only one author field.
Please ignore if all contributors are already properly listed.
codeMessages.JSON_KEY_RECOMMENDED: A JSON file is missing a key listed as recommended.
codeMessages.SIDECAR_KEY_RECOMMENDED: A data file's JSON sidecar is missing a key listed as recommended.
codeMessages.JSON_SCHEMA_VALIDATION_ERROR: Invalid JSON sidecar file. The sidecar is not formatted according the schema.
codeMessages.TSV_COLUMN_TYPE_REDEFINED: A column required in a TSV file has been redefined in a sidecar file. This redefinition is being ignored.
codeMessages.SUSPICIOUS_POSITIVE_EVENT_ONSET:
Event onsets were found more than a month after the start of recording.
If this is not a mistake, remove or consider an alternative method of representing these events.
